column1: # Sites whose retrieval and use close a gap.
# Derived, not asserted from memory: for every window the closing arm
# spans, every heterozygote it phases STRICTLY INSIDE the gap is listed.
# Those are the sites the closure rests on -- remove one and the chain
# across the gap loses a step.
# The test asserts two things per row, in the named arm:
#   RETRIEVED -- a candidate exists at the position (+/-2 bp, since an
#                insertion anchors its candidate one base past the VCF
#   USED      -- that candidate carries a non-zero PHASE_SET
# A site that stops being retrieved is a discovery or injection
# regression; one retrieved and no longer used is an admission
# regression. Either way the gap has lost the evidence that closes it,
# which a spans check alone can still pass by finding another way across.
